content: SessionEnd fires when a session terminates, with reason field: clear|resume|logout|prompt_input_exit|bypass_permissions_disabled|other. 'other' is the catch-all bucket that documentation groups crashes/kills into -- there is no distinct 'crashed' or 'killed' reason value, so SessionEnd cannot reliably distinguish a clean kill from other terminations, and per TEST-MATRIX case #9 a hard /SIGKILL of the container process likely prevents SessionEnd from running at all (no clean shutdown path) -- needs live confirmation.
